method.gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Pro, Unspecified Version)
method.operations: Public addConnection using an existing connected edge, updateConnection to a distinct resolved target, then selection and deleteSelected. Original counts asserted after each cycle. Twenty cycles per measured structural run after the same trajectory warmup.
method.cadence: Structural ABBA and final lean B/A add two idle rAF after each operation. This is NOT proof all delayed MiniMap work has settled. Primary latency is public operation to first rAF/scene draw. Dedicated ETL runs wait at least 200 ms after input plus two rAF callbacks, three cycles each, and record every MiniMap picture.
method.statistics: p50 and p95 use sorted[floor(n * p)], capped at the last entry; with 20 operations, p95 is the maximum. arithmeticMedian separately averages the two middle observations when n is even and is used in the human report.
method.timing: Headline runs have top-level phase counters and sparse GPU timer queries, with no CPU sampler, GC trace, or user timing marks. Scheduler includes backend draw and other layers; phase values are NOT additive exclusive times. rAF timestamps are not physical input-to-photon measurements.
method.diagnostics: Separate CPU sampling at 1 ms and V8, GC, and user timing traces. Trace windows include 40 initial idle frames and eight trailing rAF callbacks; operation summaries use explicit input/first-rAF or settled marks. These numbers are attribution, not headline latency.
method.quality: Fixed time 2.5, scale 0.35, and actual seeded scenes. The full main WebGL framebuffer is read with readPixels after add, reconnect, and delete, following 16 settling rAF callbacks. This excludes the composited HTML overlay and the separate MiniMap canvas. Initial and lean candidates are separately compared to the frozen baseline.
method.memory: Final cache inventory is taken once outside timing. Float64 equality positions replace duplicated per-range objects. Retained bucket/run objects are additional memory and are counted, not misrepresented as part of the 2.01 MiB numeric buffer.

minimapToggleSetups.gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Pro, Unspecified Version)
ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Pro, Unspecified Version)

limitations: The historical 85.7 ms zoom outlier had no original GC trace. Four new 240-frame cycles per fixture did not reproduce it; no cause or fix for that historical event is claimed.

Initial contiguous diagnostic scheduler/GC attribution may include delayed MiniMap work from the preceding operation. The settled and 200 ms probes identify the first scene draw and named MiniMap completion separately.
Only baseline GC attribution was recorded. No reduction in candidate GC is claimed.

MiniMap repaint on cross-scene reconnect/delete is meaningful: usableRect changes, affecting its mapping. The new hidden-by-default example setting is separate from renderer changes; MiniMap internals were not changed.
Retained cache saves transient rebuilding at the cost of numeric metadata plus bucket objects. Final ETL reconnect/upper-tail backend time is not uniformly faster.
Custom connection subclass update notifications remain on the compatibility path; exact stock view optimization chiefly benefits plain Nirvana.
